raw_segments.text: Twenty or thirty monkeys bounded away to bring him nuts and wild papas, but they fell to
fighting on the road, and it was too much trouble to go back with what was left of the
Mowgli was sore and angry as well as hungry, and he roamed through the empty city giving
the strangers hunting call from time to time, but no one answered him, and Mowgli felt that
he had reached a very bad place indeed.
All that Balu has said about the Bandar Log is true, he thought to himself.
They have no law, no hunting call, and no leader's nothing but foolish words and little
picking thievish hands, so if I am starved or killed here, it will be all my own fault,
but I must try to return to my own jungle.
